description: Least-privilege capability set for the main window (architecture.md Section 9.2). Grants only Tauri's core defaults required for the window to run. The custom commands (app_version, list/create/rename/set_conversation_tags/delete conversations, list/create/update/delete personas, set_provider_secret) are NOT authorized here: in Tauri v2 user-defined `#[tauri::command]` handlers are gated solely by being registered in `generate_handler!` (see src/lib.rs), not by a capability permission token. Capability permissions like `core:app:*` govern Tauri's built-in plugins, which this app does not use. No filesystem, shell, or network capabilities are granted to the webview (Section 9.2 least privilege).
